safe_sufficient_scope: For N<=440, every integer unit has at most22drawings. An initial literal header plus one unit therefore fits the23payload cells available before a continuation. The28-character teaching instance and a possible22-character Hebrew parameter are within this sufficient scope. No Hebrew source or wordbook is selected here.

decision: Preserve the frozen RAW bytes and report the domain limit. Do not silently split integer units, enlarge the row, change the code or claim completeness for all finite N.
